visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a pink and white striped shirt is vacuuming a gray tiled living room floor. A large TV screen and white media console are in the background, with a golden retriever dog walking past. (2) Close-up shot of the floor showing several strands of dark hair which are then sucked up by the white vacuum head. (3) The woman sits against a neutral studio background wearing a purple knit top, holding two Kérastase hair products, gesturing with her hands as she explains. (4) Close-up of her hair being brushed, followed by a side-by-side comparison of a hairbrush filled with hair versus one with much less. (5) In a bright bathroom, she applies hair wash from a pink bottle, creating white foam on her wet hair. (6) She applies serum to her scalp using a dropper and massages it with her fingertips and a white rounded scalp tool. (7) In a retail store, a beauty consultant uses a handheld diagnostic tool on the woman's scalp, displaying microscopic follicle images on a tablet. (8) The woman returns to the studio setting, holding three bottles of the hair serum and smiling warmly at the camera to conclude.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with the characteristic low-arousal hum of a vacuum motor. A female speaker enters with a high-pitched, fast-paced vocal delivery expressing surprise. The acoustic texture is clean and domestic. (2) The vacuum noise drops out as an upbeat, major-key acoustic pop BGM swells. The speaker transitions to a professional narrative tone with moderate loudness and clear articulation. (3) As the product is shown, subtle liquid splashes and textural rustling sounds are layered into the mix. (4) During the tutorial segment, high-frequency 'ding' sound effects punctuate each numbered step. The music maintains a steady 115 BPM rhythm, syncing with the quick cuts. (5) The speaker maintains a high emotional valence and energy throughout the endorsement summary. The master audio is well-compressed with a narrow dynamic range typical of social media broadcasts. Ends with a smooth fade-out of both speech and BGM.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Problem -> Personal Journey -> Product Solution -> Technical Demo -> Professional Proof -> Final Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Kérastase Genesis (粉漾芯生) hair care series by sharing a personal experience with hair loss and demonstrating the effectiveness of the product through a multi-step routine and professional scalp analysis. The video aims to build trust through a mix of personal vlog-style storytelling and expert diagnostic evidence.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the brand 'Kérastase' and the specific product line 'Genesis'. Detailed tutorial on how to use the products and showcasing the in-store scalp analysis service.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high editing density and frequent text overlays typical of short-form social media marketing. The integration of a department store diagnostic visit adds a layer of 'professional proof' to the personal influencer testimonial.
